facts.fact: Africa Data Centres is described as operating JHB1 Midrand in South Africa (14.4 MW); the description cites events up to July 2024, so the year 2024 is used.
Africa Data Centres is described as operating JHB2 Samrand in South Africa (10 MW, expanding to 20 MW); the description cites events up to July 2024, so the year 2024 is used.

Africa Data Centres is described as operating CPT1 Cape Town in South Africa (12 MW, expanding to 20 MW; three new halls added July 2024); the description cites events up to July 2024, so the year 2024 is used.
Africa Data Centres is described as operating CPT2 Cape Town in South Africa (20 MW); the description cites events up to July 2024, so the year 2024 is used.
